experiment: K16 full factorial of common-response channel sources under fixed adapted instruction amplification

block_names.H: first two executed action channels (horizontal translation after metadata validation)
block_names.S: remaining five executed channels (height, rotation, gripper after metadata validation), treated as a bundle
block_names.P: 25 unexecuted denoising padding channels; may influence later denoising

formula: at the same current observation, draft x and flow time t: muM=(vM(canonical Left)+vM(canonical Right))/2; hybrid mean takes muR in the condition-selected coordinates and muF elsewhere; velocity=(hybrid_mean + 2.959*(vF(actual q)-muF)).cast(original velocity dtype)
target_routing: actual q is forwarded directly to adapted model; never choose an external target-dependent sign or old target-specific contrast

timing.after_window: adapted native model with same actual q

snapshots: all 20 original K14 saved adapted-Front stable-grasp common snapshots, same control replay/signature/noise and global replan numbering; no outcome-dependent exclusion
engineering_gates: before full batch, init20 pilot must pass source/model/processor hashes, 16 common prefixes, exact N/HSP references; at inits20/21/22 same-input mixing selected coordinates must equal old-background output and unselected coordinates new-background output, with float32 formula and bf16 rounding documented; all blocks disjoint and exhaust32
same_input_probes: descriptive predeclared probes: initial post-snapshot action chunk for both canonical q at all20 snapshots; follow N draft path for ten denoising steps, query old/new canonical responses at each identical input; summarize old-minus-new mean by coordinates and blocks over executed first10 vs full50 horizon positions. Not a physical effect attribution or an independent confirmation set.
primary_readouts: Left and Right first correct region separately

statistics.unit: 20 physical snapshot clusters; two requested goals resampled together
statistics.factor_edges: all12 source-switch edges, preserving the other two block sources
statistics.interactions: H by S at both P levels; H by P at both S levels; S by P at both H levels; three-way interaction exploratory
statistics.interpretation: report paired effect sizes and intervals; development mechanism screen, no equivalence inference or uncorrected family-wide significance claim; no adaptive regrouping or retuning

observational_diagnostics: window-end lift, both-finger contact, displacement; per-channel arm versus gripper clipping separately. Correlation does not establish mediation.
limits: same development states and one parent/adapted pair
S is a heterogeneous bundle, not a localized module
hybrid velocity coordinates can alter later action-draft and physical states
cannot identify training update cause from inference-time output transplantation
a channel effect is not evidence that semantic knowledge is stored in that channel
